title: Colony and Protocol Again
author: Freya Zhou
blurb: Vesper Zhou, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
